prompt:
Look at the table in the image. It shows a ledger-style table with one Name column, several numeric columns, strong horizontal rules, and minimal vertical separators. Determine the requested target-column summary over the rows selected by the filter condition. Using only the rows with values in Rank from 28 to 30 inclusive, determine the mean of the Age column.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence: set "evidence" to an array containing the ordered supporting cell pairs [filter cell, target cell] for each selected row in top-to-bottom row order.
Answer: set "answer" to the exact integer filtered summary value.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236],[260,236,372,292],[374,236,486,292]],"answer":14}
